reviewer: root agent; independent of model author
comparisons: Compared Hyundai official tower photo and facade consultant daytime photo against southwest, northeast, crown, brace and podium renders. Three independently anchored tower heights, pale frames, blue-gray glazing, stone spines and flared crowns distinguish this site from SKY-L65.

Rejected first-pass uniform podium slots and fine repeated zigzag braces. Final podium has a solid stone end and rectangular relief, tall glazed stair zone and separate top ribbon; broad structural triangles stop at widened stone spines.
Confirmed separate ownership for A/B/C tower footprints. Parking podium claims no source buildings; a fifth separately authored asset owns only the department-store footprint.

Compared official department-store exterior with source-view render: five south and three east arch/circular-window bays, blue upper ribbon, stone cornices and the raised chamfered corner with clock pediment replace the erroneous 210m survey extrusion. Four previously reviewed tower/podium GLBs remain byte-identical.
limits: B216m/59F follows design participant record but conflicts with CTBUH database239.3m/63F. Exact roof-height datum, facade dimensions, podium elevation assignment and nonphotographed elevations are uncertain. Department store has official 1–7F floor-guide evidence; 34.5m main cornice and 38.5m raised corner are photo estimates, not surveyed heights. Advertising art and sculptural relief are simplified; rear elevations lack the same photographic coverage.
